title: Hyundai Water Safety Days Event!
description:
Don’t miss Hyundai Water Safety Days tomorrow, Friday, August 7, at La Jolla Shores beach from 8 a.m. - 5 p.m.! 

Get an up‑close look at San Diego Fire‑Rescue’s newest lifeguard vehicles and pick up smart tips for staying safe in the water. See you there! More info: Sandiego.gov/blog/hyundai-water-safety-days
